Test Scenario: Search for a job title that exists
Precondition: Logged in as a Jobseeker, with several jobs already posted
Test Steps: 1. Type a job title in the search box 2. Submit the search 3. Check the results
Expected Result: Jobs whose title matches the keyword are listed, and the result count is shown

Test Scenario: Search for a keyword that matches nothing
Precondition: Logged in as a Jobseeker, with several jobs already posted
Test Steps: 1. Search for a word that appears in no job 2. Check the screen
Expected Result: An empty result is shown with a message, and the page does not break
Actual Result: Result : Empty screen with no any job
Remarks: The screen is empty with no message, so the user cannot tell whether the search ran or the page failed. Raised as JD-03.

Test Scenario: Run a second search without leaving the page
Precondition: Logged in as a Jobseeker, with several jobs already posted
Test Steps: 1. Search for one keyword and note the results 2. Without reloading, clear the box and search for a different keyword 3. Compare the results with the first search
Expected Result: The results update to match the second keyword
Actual Result: Result : First Developer job are listed then Tester are listed.

Precondition: Logged in as a Jobseeker, with several jobs already posted
Test Steps: 1. Leave the search box empty 2. Submit the search
Expected Result: All jobs are listed, or the user is told to enter a keyword
Actual Result: Result : Empty screen with no any job
Remarks: An empty keyword returns nothing at all. It should either list every job or ask for a keyword. Raised as JD-02.

Precondition: Logged in as a Jobseeker, with several jobs already posted
Test Steps: 1. Search for a keyword in lower case and note the count 2. Search for the same word in capitals 3. Compare the counts
Expected Result: Both searches return the same jobs, because search should ignore letter case

Test Scenario: Search using a word from the description only
Precondition: Logged in as a Jobseeker, with several jobs already posted
Test Steps: 1. Pick a word that appears in a job description but not in its title 2. Search for it 3. Check which jobs are returned
Expected Result: Matching jobs are returned, and it is clear to the user why each one matched
Remarks: Search matches the title only, so a job is not found by a word that appears in its description. Raised as JD-04, which may be closed as working as designed.

Test Scenario: Search using a bracket or other special character
Precondition: Logged in as a Jobseeker, with several jobs already posted
Test Steps: 1. Type an opening bracket in the search box 2. Submit the search 3. Check the screen and the browser network response
Expected Result: The search runs safely and either returns no results or handles the character, without an error

Test Scenario: Search with leading and trailing spaces
Precondition: Logged in as a Jobseeker, with several jobs already posted
Test Steps: 1. Search for a keyword with spaces before and after it 2. Compare the count with the same search without spaces
Expected Result: Spaces are trimmed and both searches return the same jobs

Test Scenario: Search with a very long keyword
Precondition: Logged in as a Jobseeker, with several jobs already posted
Test Steps: 1. Paste around 500 characters into the search box 2. Submit the search
Expected Result: The search completes and returns no results, without an error or a long delay
Remarks: A 500 character keyword returns nothing, with no error and no delay.

Precondition: Logged in as a Jobseeker, on the home page
Test Steps: 1. Use the search box on the home page 2. Submit 3. Check where the user lands and what is shown
Expected Result: The user is taken to the results page and the keyword is applied

Test Scenario: Return to the results page using the back button
Precondition: A search has been run and a job has been opened from the results
Test Steps: 1. Run a search 2. Open a job from the results 3. Press the browser back button
Expected Result: The results for the same keyword are shown again

Test Scenario: Result count matches the number of jobs shown
Precondition: Logged in as a Jobseeker, with several jobs already posted
Test Steps: 1. Run a search 2. Read the number shown in the heading 3. Count the job cards on the page
Expected Result: The count in the heading matches the number of cards displayed
